scope: Proposition 6.3 (Weighted count at a fixed determinant) of the manuscript “A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound” (preprints/A-power-improvement-in-the-Heilbronn-triangle-lower-bound-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 191 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e43687a84b82e23f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a digit matrix C, with row lattice Λ of index I = DE and special-linear orbit O modulo h. For each integer t with |t| ≤ τ, let At consist of the matrices A whose columns lie in B, whose projected columns are pairwise distinct, and which satisfy A mod h ∈ O and det A = t. Then ∑ A∈At W(A) ≪ (log(2N))2 N6 I2 . (6.4)
